technique_name: Suggest a possible career path for a college student who is studying computer science
description: A college student studying computer science can pursue many potential careers. These could include software development, data science, or cybersecurity. A student can specialize in programming languages and frameworks or explore other topics such as software architecture or web development. Additionally, a computer science major could opt to move into AI or machine learning by taking courses on the subject and gaining hands-on experience.
